overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the March 31 executive session under Purpose 1 was proper, and the committee-referral allegation was declined as outside the Division's authority.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Council convened in executive session on March 31 for an improper purpose, including a performance review or interview for an appointment.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing the executive session minutes, we find that the discussions pertained to a complaint against a particular individual and therefore were appropriate for executive session under Purpose 1.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Council did not refer a March 10 appointment to the Human Resources Committee as it had voted to do.
allegations.key_passage: the Division of Open Government’s statutory authority concerns compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we therefore decline to review allegations that, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
